question: 促销期净销额占总净销额的比例是多少
sql:
WITH promo_net AS (
    SELECT SUM(s.net_amount) AS promo_net_amount
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE s.is_promo = TRUE
      AND d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
),
total_net AS (
    SELECT SUM(s.net_amount) AS total_net_amount
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(promo_net.promo_net_amount / total_net.total_net_amount * 100, 2) AS 促销期净销额占比
FROM promo_net, total_net

question: 每个大区销量最高的单品是哪个
sql:
WITH outlet_region AS (
    SELECT outlet_id, region
    FROM dim_outlet
),
sku_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        o.region,
        p.sku_name,
        SUM(s.qty) AS total_qty
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_product p ON s.sku_id = p.sku_id
    JOIN outlet_region o ON s.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
    GROUP BY o.region, p.sku_name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        sku_name,
        total_qty,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY total_qty DESC) AS rn
    FROM sku_sales
)
SELECT region AS 大区, sku_name AS 单品, total_qty AS 销量
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY region
LIMIT 200

question: 各渠道净销额占总销额的比例
sql:
SELECT 
  o.channel,
  SUM(s.net_amount) AS 净销额,
  SUM(s.gross_amount) AS 总销额,
  SUM(s.net_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(s.gross_amount), 0) AS 净销额占比
FROM fact_sales s
JOIN dim_outlet o ON s.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
GROUP BY o.channel
ORDER BY 净销额占比 DESC
LIMIT 10

question: 各大区的新品铺市率是多少
sql:
WITH outlet_sku AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT o.region, o.outlet_id, r.sku_id
    FROM dim_outlet o
    JOIN rel_outlet_sku r ON o.outlet_id = r.outlet_id
    JOIN dim_product p ON r.sku_id = p.sku_id
    WHERE p.is_new_product = TRUE
      AND o.is_active = TRUE
      AND r.listed_date <= DATE '2026-09-04'
      AND (r.delisted_date IS NULL OR r.delisted_date >= DATE '2026-09-04')
),
region_outlets AS (
    SELECT region, COUNT(DISTINCT outlet_id) AS total_outlets
    FROM dim_outlet
    WHERE is_active = TRUE
    GROUP BY region
),
region_outlet_sku AS (
    SELECT region, COUNT(DISTINCT outlet_id) AS outlets_with_new
    FROM outlet_sku
    GROUP BY region
)
SELECT 
    ro.region AS 大区,
    ROUND(ros.outlets_with_new * 100.0 / ro.total_outlets, 2) AS 新品铺市率
FROM region_outlets ro
LEFT JOIN region_outlet_sku ros ON ro.region = ros.region
ORDER BY ro.region
LIMIT 200

question: 各大区2026年8月净销额相比去年同期的增长率
sql:
WITH sales_data AS (
    SELECT 
        dl.region,
        d.year,
        d.month,
        SUM(s.net_amount) AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN dim_dealer dl ON s.dealer_id = dl.dealer_id
    WHERE d.year IN (2025, 2026) AND d.month = 8
    GROUP BY dl.region, d.year, d.month
)
SELECT 
    region,
    SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2026 THEN net_sales ELSE 0 END) AS 本期净销额,
    SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2025 THEN net_sales ELSE 0 END) AS 去年同期净销额,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2026 THEN net_sales ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2025 THEN net_sales ELSE 0 END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2025 THEN net_sales ELSE 0 END), 0) AS 同比增长率
FROM sales_data
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY 同比增长率 DESC
LIMIT 10

question: 各渠道2026年8月的单店产出相比去年同期的变化
sql:
WITH current_period AS (
    SELECT o.channel,
           COUNT(DISTINCT o.outlet_id) AS outlet_cnt,
           SUM(s.qty) AS total_qty
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN dim_outlet o ON s.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
    WHERE d.year_month = '2026-08'
    GROUP BY o.channel
),
last_year_period AS (
    SELECT o.channel,
           COUNT(DISTINCT o.outlet_id) AS outlet_cnt,
           SUM(s.qty) AS total_qty
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN dim_outlet o ON s.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
    WHERE d.year_month = '2025-08'
    GROUP BY o.channel
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(c.channel, l.channel) AS 渠道,
    (c.total_qty / NULLIF(c.outlet_cnt, 0) - l.total_qty / NULLIF(l.outlet_cnt, 0)) / NULLIF(l.total_qty / NULLIF(l.outlet_cnt, 0), 0) AS 单店产出同比变化率
FROM current_period c
FULL JOIN last_year_period l ON c.channel = l.channel
ORDER BY 单店产出同比变化率 DESC
LIMIT 10

question: 2026年上半年的费效比比2025年下半年高多少
sql:
WITH promo_cost AS (
    SELECT
        d.year_month,
        SUM(pc.cost_amount) AS total_cost
    FROM fact_promo_cost pc
    JOIN dim_date d ON pc.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY d.year_month
),
sales AS (
    SELECT
        d.year_month,
        SUM(s.net_amount) AS total_sales
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY d.year_month
),
combined AS (
    SELECT
        pc.year_month,
        pc.total_cost,
        s.total_sales,
        CASE
            WHEN pc.year_month >= '2025-07' AND pc.year_month <= '2025-12' THEN '2025H2'
            WHEN pc.year_month >= '2026-01' AND pc.year_month <= '2026-06' THEN '2026H1'
        END AS period
    FROM promo_cost pc
    JOIN sales s ON pc.year_month = s.year_month
),
period_agg AS (
    SELECT
        period,
        SUM(total_cost) AS cost,
        SUM(total_sales) AS sales
    FROM combined
    WHERE period IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY period
)
SELECT
    (SUM(CASE WHEN period = '2026H1' THEN cost / NULLIF(sales, 0) END) -
     SUM(CASE WHEN period = '2025H2' THEN cost / NULLIF(sales, 0) END)) AS 费效比差值
FROM period_agg
